description: Stage 2: Security hardening (CF Access JWT auth, headers, CSRF, purge hygiene), Mac Bridge (Node.js polling script that executes Mitchell ingest pipelines via Claude Code CLI), and Agent Portal UI (Agents tab to trigger and monitor pipeline jobs).

userStories.title: Owner authorization middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a server-side auth helper that validates the Cloudflare Access JWT so every protected route has a second security layer beyond the edge.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/auth.ts exported function requireOwner(request: Request): Promise<void>
Reads JWT from Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header
Fetches Cloudflare JWKS from https://<CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN>/cdn-cgi/access/certs and validates JWT signature using the jose library
Verifies aud claim equals CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUDIENCE env var
Verifies email claim equals BRIEFING_HUB_OWNER_EMAIL env var
Throws a Response with status 401 and body {"error":"Unauthorized"} on any validation failure
Fails closed (throws 401) if any of the three required env vars is absent, UNLESS NODE_ENV !== 'production' AND DEV_SKIP_AUTH=true
.env.example updated with BRIEFING_HUB_OWNER_EMAIL=, CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN=, CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUDIENCE=, DEV_SKIP_AUTH=false
jose added to package.json dependencies
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Hub Bridge API — poll and claim endpoints
userStories.description: As the Mac Bridge, I need to poll for the next queued job and atomically claim it so no two Bridge instances can run the same job.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/bridge/jobs/next?wait_seconds=N endpoint created
Returns 401 if Authorization: Bearer <BRIDGE_SECRET> is missing or wrong
Polls jobs table for next status='queued' row for up to wait_seconds (max 30) using polling loop with 500ms sleep; returns { job } with status 200 when found
Returns 204 (no body) if no job found within timeout
POST /api/bridge/jobs/[id]/claim endpoint created
Atomically sets status='claimed' and claimed_at=now() using UPDATE WHERE status='queued'; returns 200 with job row on success
Returns 409 { "error": "already claimed" } if job is not in queued status
Returns 401 without valid BRIDGE_SECRET
BRIDGE_SECRET added to .env.example

userStories.title: Hub Bridge API — progress, complete, fail endpoints

POST /api/bridge/jobs/[id]/complete accepts { result_json?: string }; sets status='succeeded', finished_at=now(), stores result_json; returns 200 { ok: true }; requires BRIDGE_SECRET
POST /api/bridge/jobs/[id]/fail accepts { error_message: string }; sets status='failed', finished_at=now(), stores error_message; returns 200 { ok: true }; requires BRIDGE_SECRET

userStories.title: Bridge polling loop
userStories.description: As the Mac Bridge, I need a resilient polling loop that claims and runs jobs, handling network errors with exponential backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: bridge/poll.js exports startPolling(config) that continuously long-polls GET <HUB_URL>/api/bridge/jobs/next?wait_seconds=20 with Authorization: Bearer <BRIDGE_SECRET>
On HTTP 200: immediately POSTs to /api/bridge/jobs/:id/claim; if claim returns 200 dispatches to runner; if 409 re-polls immediately
On HTTP 204: re-polls immediately
On network error or unexpected HTTP status: logs the error and waits with exponential backoff starting at 5 seconds, doubling up to 60 seconds max, then re-polls
On SIGINT or SIGTERM: stops accepting new jobs; if a job is running waits for it to finish or 30 seconds then exits with code 0
bridge/index.js calls startPolling(config) after startup validation
Typecheck passes
